samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: A single standard approach to online university classes should be required for everyone, regardless of their needs. Do you agree or disagree?
requirementsVi: Phản đối việc áp dụng một cách cứng nhắc cho tất cả.
Giải thích trở ngại và khác biệt hoàn cảnh.
Thừa nhận lợi ích và đề xuất cách linh hoạt hơn.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to online university classes, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some learners may feel isolated. This matters because a screen does not always make it easy to ask a quick question or form friendships. For instance, a first-year student may stop working on a difficult task instead of asking a classmate for help. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion. This can help explain why some learners may feel isolated. Consider the following situation: a first-year student may stop working on a difficult task instead of asking a classmate for help. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. The possibility that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to schedule small weekly discussion groups. A teacher could meet six students at a time and ask each person to explain one difficult point.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.

samples.summaryVi: Tư vấn học nghề mở thêm lựa chọn; cần hiểu nội dung học và điều kiện làm việc trước khi chọn.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: It is sometimes suggested that everyone should follow one standard approach to vocational education, regardless of their needs. I disagree with this view. A shared goal can be useful, but an identical rule may ignore the practical conditions that determine whether people can benefit from it.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phản đối sự cứng nhắc, không phủ nhận toàn bộ chủ đề.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 1 — điều kiện khác nhau
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that students might choose too early with limited information. This matters because a course title alone does not explain future working conditions or entry requirements. For instance, a young person may enrol in a hospitality course without realising that some jobs involve evening shifts. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tư vấn học nghề mở thêm lựa chọn; cần hiểu nội dung học và điều kiện làm việc trước khi chọn.

paragraphs.label: Lý do 2 — nguyên nhân cần xử lý
paragraphs.text: One reason for the difficulty is that career advice sometimes focuses on prestige instead of the details of each route. This can help explain why students might choose too early with limited information. Consider the following situation: a young person may enrol in a hospitality course without realising that some jobs involve evening shifts. It shows that the problem is connected with the way the activity is organised, not only with an individual's attitude. Unless that underlying condition changes, asking people to try harder may have little effect.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích vì sao yêu cầu cố gắng hơn chưa đủ.

paragraphs.label: Thừa nhận và hướng khác
paragraphs.text: This does not mean that the original idea has no value. For example, a teenager who enjoys repairing machines may benefit from visiting a technical training centre. The possibility that students can discover routes that match practical interests is worth taking seriously. However, a better approach would be to provide course visits and balanced guidance about work and further study. Schools could invite former students from several training routes to discuss both the benefits and difficulties.
paragraphs.noteVi: Thừa nhận điểm mạnh và đưa giải pháp có điều kiện.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, I do not support requiring one method for everyone. A workable policy should keep its main purpose while allowing practical adjustments. This is more likely to help people participate than a rigid rule that treats different circumstances as if they were the same.
paragraphs.noteVi: Chốt đúng đối tượng phản đối: một phương pháp cho mọi người.
